en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town featuring unpaved streets and rows of modest wooden and clapboard houses with porches. In the foreground is a dark rectangular utility building on a corner lot. Behind it stand multiple single‑story homes and, farther back, several larger multi‑story Victorian‑style buildings with gabled roofs and turrets. The area appears flat with open land beyond the town. A visible sign on one building reads "OXNARD LIGHT & WATER CO.", indicating a local utility company. The image is bordered like a printed card, consistent with an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.
